brief:
Burger King apologized to an Israeli customer after an employee shouted "Free Palestine" during a service interaction, We Are Not Numbers reported. The fast-food chain responded to the incident, though details of the customer's complaint and the company's specific response remain unclear.

The exchange reflects ongoing tensions amid the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, which have spilled into commercial spaces and customer service settings in recent months.
dek: “Burger King apologizes to Israeli customer after employee shouts ‘Free Palestine.'”
title: Burger King apologizes after worker shouts pro-Palestine slogan at Israeli customer
